reference_sql:
SELECT country_code, ROUND(AVG(net_revenue_eur), 2) AS avg_line_revenue_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY country_code
alternatives: SELECT country_code, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(net_revenue_eur), 2) AS avg_line_revenue_eur FROM sales GROUP BY 1
SELECT country_code, ROUND(AVG(net_revenue_eur), 2) AS avg_line_revenue_eur FROM sales WHERE net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country_code

other_way.sql: SELECT country_code, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(net_revenue_eur), 2) AS avg_line_revenue_eur FROM sales GROUP BY 1
